posts.title: Weaknotes: November 16–18, 2026
posts.description: Monday, November 16 I'm in conversation with a man from my past, a co-worker I disliked. He follows me through a doorway into a carpeted banquet room. I turn to face him and notice something on the floor. "You've dropped an Andes mint," I say. Looking more closely, I see it's actually a package of Oreo-type cookies masquerading as Newtons. posts.title: Blue Wave / Green Thoughts
posts.description: The midterms are over—a magnificent blue wave knocked out the ruling party and restored some of my faith in our beleaguered country. After a decade of MAGA cruelty and corruption, it finally seems like the tide is turning. America has a lot to celebrate this week.
